[element-award-id]
=== `<award-id>` Award Identifier

An identifier that has been assigned to the award, for example, a grant number, a grant reference number, or a contract number.

#### Usage/Remarks
Note that this element holds a real-world identifier, not an XML `ID`. This element holds an external identifier, assigned to a contract, grant, stipend, or other award by the awarding agency. The contents of this element should not be confused with the <<attribute-id,`@id`>> attribute, which holds an internal document identifier that can be used by software to construct a simple link within the XML-tagged standard.
